Record Class MeasureStatus

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.MeasureStatus
Record Components:
entry - the bound as the ledger declares it
observed - the session's value, or null when the measure was not taken
public record MeasureStatus(MeasureEntry entry, Double observed) extends Record
How one ledger bound fared against the session's measures.

A violated bound raises a finding under "measure/" plus the measure key, so it travels the same road as every other finding: ATTENTION in the receipt, the gate in mode: gate, and the per-entry mode: report exemption. A bound whose measure was not taken this session is neither passed nor violated; the receipt says so.
